name: 大字留白
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / book cover concept sheet.
Create one refined, realistic visual design concept for a flexible leather notebook in the existing StoryOS study.
Input image 1 is the CURRENT APPLICATION HOME ROUTE in its unselected overview state. It is the authoritative environment, exposure, color grading, and lighting reference. Input image 2 is an unmodified screenshot clip of the front-left closed book from that SAME HOME FRAME. It is the authoritative dark leather, book shape, stand and local shading reference.
CRITICAL: preserve the dim room exactly. Do not add lights, fill lights, spotlights, rim light, HDR, boosted exposure or lifted shadows. Do not light up the leather just to make text readable. Existing low warm ambient/candle light and cool window light must remain as shown. The book's leather in the close-up must be as dark as in the home overview, not a brightly lit product photo. Only the proposed lettering/surface treatment should improve local readability.
Output: a clean 1536 x 1536 concept sheet containing ONE design direction. Top half: the same full-room overview from input 1, same camera/composition and dim exposure; apply the proposed cover treatment to the existing front-left book only. Bottom half: two equal square detail panels, enlarged views of that same book on that same wooden stand, same oblique orientation and identical dim illumination. Left detail uses the Chinese title; right detail uses the long English title. These are two title-length examples of the SAME cover design, not different styles. Keep the book fully inside each detail panel with generous visible dark wood around it. Separate panels with a narrow dark gutter. No panel captions, no option numbers, no graphic badges, no new product UI. The application UI chrome may be omitted to keep the board focused on the book.
Physical invariants: same thin softly flexible leather cover, rounded worn edges, same book thickness and size, same paper block and stand. The book stays closed. No hands, open pages, straps, buckles, metal corners, added illustration, invented author, subtitle, crest or emblem. Preserve understated private-manuscript character.
Exact cover text: Chinese "星海余烬"; English "A Catalogue of Forgotten Stars and the Roads Between Them".
Text must be correct and complete, with no additional words. Chinese title is naturally proportioned and clearly readable; English uses intentional word-based line breaks, never split a word. Treat title as variable user input: the short title should have a deliberate scale and ample whitespace, and the long title should form a balanced multiline block with a readable type size. Reserve a generous safe title area. The cover color/material, typography character, alignment and texture should follow the SINGLE design direction below.

Single design direction: Large literary title and quiet whitespace. Retain the original dark leather. Use muted warm-gray ink and strong, exceptionally clear book typography: Chinese with substantial Song/Ming-inspired strokes and an elegant medium-weight literary serif for English. Title is the primary visual element, larger than the other approaches, occupying a deliberate block across the middle third of the cover while leaving the lower cover substantially empty. Chinese title can use two lines of two characters, balanced and confident, never oversized to the cover edges. Long English uses a strong four-line left-aligned block with excellent spacing. No ornaments or borders. Restrained authored-volume identity; strong typography without losing warm leather.

Top overview book: ONLY Chinese 星海余烬, no English subtitle. Each panel uses exactly one title. In the Chinese detail deliberately use two lines: 星海 on the first line, 余烬 on the second. The four characters must be correctly written; 烬 has the fire radical 火 and 尽. Keep original dim lighting and dark leather.
